text: Zoho CRM is the primary system of record, on per-user seats
Two Zoho orgs — Leads and Investor
Supabase is the read model — two projects, leads and investors
Write-through: the portal writes the mirror from Zoho’s answer in the same request
Business rules are enforced in Zoho (blueprints, validation rules, custom functions, field-level security)
Staff sign in with Zoho (OAuth 2.0, per-user tokens); investors sign in with Supabase
eMudhra is the permanent signature authority
Documents live only in Zoho; the app fetches on demand
The gate model — the IR owns and moves the lead; Finance confirms; nothing transfers
The app account opens at the first confirmed money, tentative; permanent at full payment; locked seven days later
The handover creates the Contact at “said yes”; the lead continues; the close copy fills the placeholders at Onboarded
Account Management sits in the Investor org; KAMs are Team users; named at allotment; measured on service
Sensitive data: encrypted fields in Zoho behind field-level security; masked only in the mirror; Aadhaar never stored; reveals logged; bank beneficiary via the bank where possible
AWS S3 with Object Lock is the backup target and the exit; a VPS or NAS is at most a third copy; never a second live system
The FMS stays a separate vertical; farm progress arrives by webhook into the investors project; nothing farm-related goes to Zoho
Every finding of the cross-analysis is a register item, ticked with a note when fixed

Email is sent from the portal as the person through Zoho’s Send Mail API with Zoho email templates; uploads attach to the Zoho record (KYC files in a restricted module); approvals are Zoho approval processes; automation is workflow rules logged as system touches
Automation is catalogued (§21) and bounded by six honesty rules

The failure-mode analysis is adopted: reversal events, one actor per consequence, delegation everywhere, a KYC step, recording always allowed, an allow-list mapper, a real job runner, a heartbeat that lives elsewhere — and eleven canaries in place of the six alerts

Seats are bought per org at the cheapest edition that carries the features that org actually uses — Professional for Leads if the trial confirms it, Enterprise for Investor, Team users for KAMs; Zoho One only if the company adopts the suite
KYC is a switch a person sets, money is typed and checked against the bank statement weekly, and the Leads org holds four or five seats — not thirteen

Step-up authentication on eight authoritative actions; the bank statement is the second hand for ordinary receipts and an administrator is the second hand for money leaving; one seat per human inside Finance
Whether Leads and Investor share one Zoho org is decided by a sandbox test in week one, not by argument
A Zoho seat is required to write, never to read — read-only staff hold a portal login and no CRM licence
The master dashboard leaves the thirteen weeks and becomes its own conversation
The portals are Next.js App Router and TypeScript, with no UI kit, no state library and the prototype's own stylesheet as the design system
The console looks like a product: Inter embedded, an icon set, one control family, Airtable-style pills and tabs — UI only, the UX untouched
The console is a page that scrolls, styled on shadcn/ui's tokens and components — the fixed one-screen frame is gone; the workflow is untouched
Every door on the lead page opens in its own browser window; the short forms stay in the drawer
The console has a sign-in screen; the seat picker is gone
Updates moves into a bell; People becomes Team & access and stays
The 52 findings of the design review are fixed in the prototype
Every page is one screen; what left it opens from a door
Fewer destinations — Add lead and Team & access come off the rail, neither losing a capability
What the restore broke and how it was caught; My day says what kind of work a row is; one line of filters; Events create, change and remove
Work queue alignment and user, record, reporting and temporary-access visibility boundaries
Content-sized timeline icons, cards, controls and layouts that respond to available width
IR weekly recorded-work totals and a focused Today page without duplicate summary cards
Lead operators and business viewers, own-assigned Channel Partners, account-menu Profile and explicit sensitive access
Honest demo/browser freshness status and session-safe five-minute pending saves with explicit retry
IR read-only Finance payment/document histories for current held leads, with portal source records and a single writer
Investor copy at signed agreements and Finance-confirmed 10%, retained lead/IR ownership and guarded manual recovery
Dormant secondary privacy, active leave/handover access and read-only IR-manager team Finance oversight
Zero copy: the console reads and writes Zoho live — supersedes D3/D4; a short-TTL read-only cache is allowed, a second store is not; three System checks retired, two added

Q30 and Q31 answered from Zoho's documentation: concurrency binds, not credits; no token reads two orgs, so the cross-org read moves to a second server-held credential and costs an Investor-org seat; the stage sheets placed under zero copy

Three log planes — the record audit read live, the org audit archived, and the console's own operational and security log, which zero copy never forbade; resolves O-01 and corrects D45's API-headroom check
The IM portal comes onto the console's design architecture — a rewrite, not a restyle; shared by a generated fence, not a link; and step-up is built for the portal, never borrowed
Four blockers closed — two bounded cross-org service identities, console state split by what it actually is, a dedicated touch object, and the fifteen-minute undo dropped
The last three blockers closed, and the drift they revealed — five business rules now enforced outside Zoho; D5 amended; the edition question reopened as a measurement (T14)
One Enterprise org, production included, built outward from the super admin; if D23's identity wall holds, the cross-org machinery of D46/D49 is dropped

One Enterprise org for leads and investors — supersedes D02; field-level security is the identity wall; the Lead carries all seven rungs and the Contact is linked at 'said yes'; the cross-org machinery of D46/D49 is dropped
Every human holds a full Enterprise seat; the cache is keyed by visibility scope, because a shared cache would serve one user's numbers to another

The org as found: hold D52 (stop native conversion, Deals become history), adopt the existing LLP modules as shelf and Allotments with a new Receipts module, Aadhaar to last-4 + reference with the full number hidden, and the wall before any second seat

The lead page answers one question — what happens next: tap-only log (reach · what happened · what's next), one Activity feed, one More menu; email composed in the console, sent via Zoho only when the owner presses Send

The lead page scored element by element by Jev over five rounds (clutter 3.43 → 0.47 of 4); ~6 controls until the IR acts, the logging flow opens in place one question at a time, one Investor file drawer; 11 elements plateau at 0.64–0.89 with Jev's top pick matching

Inside the logging flow, one question at a time: answered steps collapse to one line, the channel is never re-asked, a loss is one question that saves the contact and the loss together, the last tap saves with a 10-second Undo; Jev load 2.4–2.75 → 0.04–0.19

Latest note on the Next step card; a time question for calls and meetings (pre-highlights the investor's stated time); next steps map to Zoho Calls (reminder, CRM calendar), Meetings (two-way Zoho Calendar sync) or Tasks

Every page brought in line with the lead page by Jev scoring (564 elements; mean clutter 1.21 → 0.69; top pick matches 77% → 88%), and the IR manager's 'Assignments by IR' report on Numbers (four non-overlapping periods, cohort, worked = owner touch, breakdown one tap away)

Three console seats (IR, IR Manager, Digital Infrastructure; everyone else by grant; Finance/Marketing never), org-wide top-bar search with read-only peek, Transfers analytics (said-yes by month), Overdue filter fixed, IR paperwork steps inline on the lead page (the writers had been unreachable) and no page-reloading loops; Jev paperwork load 1.62–3.65 → 0.05–0.27

Paperwork shows as the IR's move on Today (button or chip) and Documents, and opens the lead's paperwork row; writes stay on the lead page. Digital Infrastructure may grant IRs extra pages (confirmed)

IR console delivery plan replaces plan.xlsx: 15 epics, 86 stories, 229 subtasks, 310 test cases (247 automated, judged by Jev: 232 PASS · 12 REVIEW · 3 FAIL = real prototype gaps); waterfall S0–S5 28 Sep–13 Dec with stage gates; pm/IR-Console-Delivery-Plan.xlsx

Jev gap review of the D62 plan → added E16 quality engineering and E17 launch readiness plus PM sheets (brief/KPIs, ways of working, test strategy, risks, dependencies, change log, budget, traceability); Jev becomes the main tester via a UI runner (plain-language steps, per-fact judging, fixtures); 190 PASS / 16 REVIEW / 5 FAIL (real gaps) on the prototype, 16/16 seeded-wrong caught, 0–1 clear false passes in 494 near-miss facts; PASS at ≥ 0.80

Owner confirms Jev as the main tester: the Jev UI runner runs every UI case (prototype now, staging after each deploy); PASS ≥ 0.80 per fact, REVIEW to the tester; a run counts only if every seeded-wrong case fails and near-miss false passes ≤ 1%

IR console in three weeks (28 Sep – 16 Oct, live Mon 19 Oct), IM portal in two (19 – 30 Oct, live Mon 2 Nov), built by a hands-off autopilot: one command loops Claude Code one story per round, Jev tests each story, people get BLOCKED.md and a calendar; daily Cowork check reports; both workbooks rebuilt every round

Progress-based, not calendar-based: the autopilot runs round the clock from 24 Sep, target everything (IR then IM) built by Sat 3 Oct, then test & harden; dates are projections from measured pace (autopilot/status.mjs, Progress sheet); everything tracked in Slack #growize-app-documents (per-round webhook posts, tracker canvas, 3× daily Cowork summary)

Sahil is the super user of the merged console: every page and action of both sides (incl. PAN/Aadhaar/bank reveals, logged) so one account tests every feature; Finance (Harsha) stays the primary doer of money and paperwork, Compliance of KYC, Account Management of care — their queues stay theirs and are labelled so; Investors-side browser dialogs replaced by in-page refusals and confirmations
Search stays separate: top-bar search = leads only in the searcher's book; investor search on the Investors page; an IR sees investor data only for investors from their own lead (mechanism open, OD2)

Documents and payments have three scopes — personal (Contact), allotment (investor × LLP, incl. Receipts), project (LLP); prototype's investor-only DOCS/TXN and Blocks A–F map to the real LLP/allotment modules; canonical allotment module open (OD1)
Upload straight from the console to Zoho (Attachments API / ZFS + file-upload fields, 20 MB, allowlist, own token, no copy) — nobody uses the Zoho UI to upload

Zoho Sign inside the console: send from template/PDF, HMAC webhooks for status, signed PDF filed to the allotment, investor signs by email or embedded in the app, record emails via the viewer's own token; per-user isolation suite; needs a Sign plan with API (AP3)
Tickets and investor updates are pushed to the existing investor app through the signed contracts; stub receiver until the app codebase is added (MA1)

Owner answers: allotments live in LLP_Unit_Allocation (extend it); an IR's own investors = the lead owner at Said yes, enforced by a Zoho record share; renewal off our list; Zoho writes approved if the mapping is right — 75-row mapping checked with Jev, 36 fields created in production (Contacts 20, allotment 10, LLP 6), 2 held, modules/Setup items listed

Correction: allotments live in LLP_UnitAllocation_Module (active investors), restoring D54; 9 fields created and verified there; existing Total_Amount_Received/Receivable, Reserved_Units, Customer_Status reused; the 10 D74 fields on LLP_Unit_Allocation to be deleted in Setup

One shared Touches module for IR touches and KAM conversations (Jev 0.64 vs 0.30); Cases enabled + 3 fields; Receipts, Touches, Investor Updates modules created with Jev-trimmed fields; Lead_Source values added; history on App_Account_Mark; Documents module, 'Darft' fix, field deletions and FLS held

No Documents module (owner + Jev 0.95): files stay in slots/Attachments per investor, allotment, LLP; signing read live from Zoho Sign; 10 unused LLP_Unit_Allocation fields deleted after an emptiness check; access plan drafted (docs/ACCESS-PLAN.md) with R1 Administrator-bypass decision

Access plan approved; Sahil stays Administrator (owner/developer); Compliance and Auditor one seat; every paper can arrive by Zoho Sign or manual upload into the same slot, both verified the same way; Zoho Sign is on Free Edition (no API/webhooks) — upgrade needed for integration

23 paper-tracking fields created (NDA on Lead; FEMA/PAN/bank on Contact; supplementary/allocation letter/unit certificate on allotment). Integrations corrected: staff Zoho OAuth; investors Supabase; mail is Google Workspace via CRM Send Mail (not Zoho Mail); Google Calendar sync; Zoho Sign needs upgrade; templates via a small Mail Templates module (CRM API can't write templates); SPF has 3 records — fix

Mail Templates module + 5 seeded templates; role tree (11 roles) and default sharing applied (Emails now Private; farms, updates, templates Public Read Only); sharing rules, profiles and field-level security not applied — access grants left to the owner

Personal template copies (Shared/Personal + Copied_From, 10 per user, console-enforced); "Darft" label fixed to Draft (API value unchanged); SPF note posted to Slack; minimal money model proposed (units × price, receipts, everything else computed); payouts/TDS open

Investor Payouts module (one record per monthly payout, 60 per 5-yr allotment; tab on investor page + Finance due queue, no new page); "Claimed" added to Receipts.Match_State; Campaigns activated for events (+Leads.Event); Sales Plans module; Lead_Status ladder values added (6 old values blocked by Blueprint "Lead nurturing process"); 41 empty extra fields verified but removal left to owner

Events become 3 fields on the lead (Event_Name/Date/Channel), no Events page, Campaigns switched off again; leads come in from a Google Sheet loaded in the console with preview + duplicate check (M04-S04 In plan)

Events back to the portal design (event records, Events page, CSV load tagged to an event, portal owner rules + manual Assign owner); event store in Zoho awaits owner choice (Campaigns vs custom module); TDS not computed
Lead Events module (portal event record + staff roster + load log) and Leads.Lead_Event created; D83 lead event fields deleted; 41 empty legacy fields deleted (34 allotment, 7 Contacts)

Investor app access is run from the console, never the Zoho UI: accounts open On hold (data synced, sign-in locked, no email); Finance presses Send welcome and unlock; add already-paid investors from the Investors page; read-only audited View as investor. Adds M09-S09, M10-S21, M10-S22; M08-S08 opens on hold

Tracker shows done and waiting apart; 66 FRONT-END LOOP notes become phase 2b "wire" units (64 units, 32 loop h); review no longer holds a phase; BLOCKED.md counted by kind; UAT is a dated stage with entry criteria

Phase 2c "harden" in a parallel worktree: route contract suite (M18-S14), browser/request hardening (M18-S15), webhook tests (M12-S05-H5), Jev failure triage (M19-S12), UAT pack (M18-S08-H5/H6); 5 units, 12.5 loop h; phase 3 waits for the sandbox

Jev rulings sheet over all open PROVISIONAL/FACT CHANGE lines with decisions + rules as state (docs/reports/rulings-2026-09-29.md: 15 reverse, 4 confirm, 12 needs-you, 78 undecided); jev decide attaches cited decisions automatically
One Jev layer (M19-S13, phase 2c): shared client, grounding, versioned questions, calibration and threshold per question type, owner never-list; UI runner migrates with questions/PASS_AT unchanged
